name: Psyche
tagline: First mission to a metal-rich M-class asteroid
description: NASA's mission to a ~230-km M-type asteroid believed to be the exposed metal core of a differentiated proto-planet. Launched 2023-10-13 on a Falcon Heavy from Kennedy LC-39A; uses four SPT-140 Hall-effect ion thrusters as the primary cruise propulsion and a 2026 Mars gravity assist en route to a 2029 Psyche rendezvous. Carries a magnetometer, multispectral imager, and gamma-ray + neutron spectrometer.
best_known_for: First mission to a metal-rich M-class asteroid
